tc_name: Load Amazon URL from URL bar
description: Validate that entering a full Amazon URL into the URL bar loads the Amazon search/page and displays search result snippet.
precondition: Device has active internet connection. Chrome is launched on Google sdk_gphone64_x86_64.

steps.step_desc: Tap the URL bar labeled 'Search or type URL'.
steps.expected: URL bar is focused and keyboard appears.

steps.step_desc: Enter the Amazon URL exactly: 'https://www.amazon.in/?&tag=googinhydmabk-21&ref=pd_sl_50mih90ikb_e&adgrpid=159067175652&hvpone=&hvptwo=&hvadid=674834481301&hvpos=&hvnetw=g&hvrand=13327485234546991' and submit.
steps.expected: Browser navigates and page or search results load. Search results include snippet text 'Shop online at Amazon India' and 'Shopping Made Convenient — Amazon offers an array of unique products from hundreds of brands.' or the Amazon home content appears.

tc_name: Open home page using home button
description: Verify tapping the home button navigates to the browser home (Discover) page and displays home content.
precondition: Chrome is launched and not currently on the home page.

steps.step_desc: Tap the home button with label 'Open the home page'.
steps.expected: Browser navigates to the home/Discover page.

steps.step_desc: Verify visible UI text on the home page.
steps.expected: Discover content is visible including 'Continue with this tab', 'Can't refresh Discover', and stories or suggestions.

description: Validate browser behavior when there is no network connectivity and user attempts to navigate.
precondition: Device network is disabled (airplane mode) and Chrome is launched.

steps.step_desc: In the URL bar 'Search or type URL' enter a query like 'amazon' and submit.
steps.expected: Navigation fails and page displays 'No internet connection' prominently.

steps.step_desc: Observe home/discover area.
steps.expected: Home shows 'Can't refresh Discover' and 'Check back later for new stories' or similar offline messages.

tc_name: Display SSL certificate error for invalid authority
description: When connecting to a site with an invalid certificate authority, the browser should show 'Your connection is not private' with NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID.
precondition: Device has internet but the target site is served with an invalid/untrusted certificate (or device date misconfigured).

steps.step_desc: Navigate to 'https://www.amazon.in' or the recorded Amazon URL in the URL bar.
steps.expected: Browser shows 'Your connection is not private' and the error code 'NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID'.

steps.step_desc: Verify presence of action buttons on the warning page.
steps.expected: Buttons 'Back to safety' and 'Advanced' are visible.

tc_name: Advanced option on SSL warning allows reveal of proceed option
description: Validate that tapping 'Advanced' on the SSL warning reveals additional options (such as allowing proceed) and that proceeding behaves as expected.
precondition: SSL warning 'Your connection is not private' is displayed (NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID).

steps.step_desc: On the 'Your connection is not private' page tap 'Advanced'.
steps.expected: 'Advanced' section expands and additional details about the certificate and a 'Proceed to www.amazon.in (unsafe)' or similar proceed link is displayed.

steps.step_desc: Tap the 'Proceed to www.amazon.in (unsafe)' link (if present).
steps.expected: Browser attempts to load the site despite the warning. Page content may be shown, or the app may continue to block depending on security policy. App should not crash.

tc_name: Handle malformed URL input in URL bar
description: Ensure that entering a malformed URL or partial query into the URL bar results in a search or proper handling, not a crash.
precondition: Chrome is launched and has internet connectivity.

steps.step_desc: Enter the malformed/partial URL 'google.com/search?gs_ssp=eJzj4tDP1TfITc9OV2A0YHRg8GJLzE2sys8' into 'Search or type URL' and submit.
steps.expected: Browser performs a search or navigates to a valid URL. Results show search content (e.g., Google results) and the app does not crash.

steps.step_desc: Verify the search results contain relevant text such as 'Amazon' when query parameters include q=amazon.
steps.expected: Search results are displayed. UI shows result snippets like 'Sponsored result' or 'Amazon.in' where applicable.

tc_name: Accept and display very long URL input
description: Verify the URL bar accepts extremely long URLs (scrollable) and navigation can be initiated without UI breakage.
precondition: Chrome is launched and device has internet connectivity.

steps.step_desc: Paste or enter the very long Amazon URL used in recorded actions into 'Search or type URL'.
steps.expected: URL bar displays the long text (scrollable/truncated) and no UI overlap or crash occurs.

steps.step_desc: Submit the long URL to begin navigation.
steps.expected: Navigation is initiated; either page loads or appropriate error (SSL/connection) is shown. App remains responsive.

tc_name: Presence of 'Continue with this tab' on home page
description: Verify that the home page shows the 'Continue with this tab' control and related Discover content.
precondition: Chrome is launched and on home/Discover page.

steps.step_desc: Open the home page by tapping 'Open the home page' or launching Chrome when home is default.
steps.expected: Home/Discover page is visible.

steps.step_desc: Locate the label or control that reads 'Continue with this tab'.
steps.expected: The text 'Continue with this tab' is visible on the home page along with Discover stories and 'Can't refresh Discover'.

tc_name: Back to safety prevents navigation from SSL warning
description: Verify that tapping 'Back to safety' on the 'Your connection is not private' page prevents navigation to the unsafe site and returns user to a safe page.
precondition: SSL warning page 'Your connection is not private' is displayed.

steps.step_desc: On the 'Your connection is not private' page tap 'Back to safety'.
steps.expected: Browser returns to the previous safe page or search results. The unsafe site is not loaded.

steps.step_desc: Attempt to access the site again via the URL bar and expect the warning to reappear.
steps.expected: When trying to navigate again the browser either re-displays 'Your connection is not private' or blocks navigation. No credentials or insecure inputs are exposed.

tc_name: Page load performance for Amazon page
description: Measure time to load Amazon page under normal network conditions and ensure acceptable performance.
precondition: Device has a stable high-speed internet connection. Chrome is launched.

steps.step_desc: Enter the Amazon URL into 'Search or type URL' and submit.
steps.expected: Navigation begins and page load timer starts.

steps.step_desc: Measure time to first meaningful paint and full page load.
steps.expected: Page loads and displays 'Shop online at Amazon India' within acceptable threshold (e.g., under 5 seconds). No UI freezes.

description: Verify clicking a search result while offline shows appropriate error messaging rather than crashing.
precondition: Device network is disabled and Google search results showing 'Sponsored result' and 'Amazon.in' are visible in current view.

steps.step_desc: Tap the 'Amazon.in' sponsored result in the search results.
steps.expected: Navigation fails and the browser shows 'No internet connection' or appropriate offline error. The app does not crash.

steps.step_desc: Observe any on-screen messages.
steps.expected: UI displays 'No internet connection' and guidance such as 'Can't refresh Discover' if on home; user is not able to load remote content.

tc_name: Robustness when repeatedly tapping home button
description: Verify that rapid repeated taps on 'Open the home page' do not cause instability or crashes and that home remains visible.
precondition: Chrome is launched and not currently on home page.

steps.step_desc: Rapidly tap the 'Open the home page' button multiple times (e.g., 10 times within 5 seconds).
steps.expected: App remains responsive, does not crash, and lands on the home/Discover page.

steps.step_desc: Verify home page content after the rapid taps.
steps.expected: Discover content is displayed with 'Continue with this tab' and no rendering errors.
